scope: Windows physical keyboard and mouse routed by screen edges to a paired Mac and back to Windows
implemented: Authenticated remote display inventory with native monitor identities
Native layout editor binds every local and remote monitor to actual geometry
Explicit application of an immutable layout snapshot and manual enabling

integration_fixes.idle_worker: Maintain an inactive worker only after endpoint clock and peer/ownership liveness checks; do not Reset or Arm. Three regressions cover 12-second pauses, 12-second local ownership followed by reverse takeover, and stopping maintenance after disconnect or lease expiry.
integration_fixes.readiness_boundary: Retain the bounded ordered Received tail when SessionReady and later runtime records arrive in the same pump; preserve receive timestamps and reject premature, duplicate, mismatched or oversized batches. Includes a deterministic real encrypted localhost regression with mock native adapters.
